reason: The agent plans a single "modify items" action which is irreversible and locks out further modify/cancel, yet only the speaker swap item is being collected while the address change is also requested on the same pending order #W6750959. Policy requires collecting all items to be changed before this one-time call and confirming explicitly; taking modify_items without first securing the address action (and the user's refusal to re-provide the address) risks an unfulfilled request or policy-violating state. Also, the user is declining to state the NY address, relying on an order to a different user's/same profile address, which the agent should not assume.
